audio/en/374013d45df92bbadb0b.m4a.text: Cybersecurity combines technologies, policies, standards, and management practices.

audio/en/af1d2607ffb617a39bea.m4a.text: Organizations need cybersecurity because they depend on information systems.

audio/en/c04777aa74fb415c2781.m4a.text: Accidental exposure of sensitive information can still be a security breach.

audio/en/41a6fc9dcff8e97cd8ac.m4a.text: The CIA triad consists of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

audio/en/402b760d04625d4830fb.m4a.text: Denial of service attacks threaten availability.

audio/en/50537065a42d31ad4cc6.m4a.text: Authenticity concerns whether an identity or information source is genuine.

audio/en/8b8b440655a211728e7a.m4a.text: The security cycle contains planning, protection, and response.

audio/en/8675e9a571f0df49751f.m4a.text: Protection implements the controls and operations defined by the security plan.

audio/en/99b078b197c82b733e07.m4a.text: The sample quiz defines response as recovery according to plan.

audio/en/ad29d3b702a2ace63f22.m4a.text: A threat landscape describes relevant attackers, capabilities, and attack methods.

audio/en/e42e238f2ffddb5e04a7.m4a.text: Attack motivation explains why an attacker acts.

audio/en/01e551fc24a04c17a5ce.m4a.text: Automation, speed, and remote reach can increase the scale of online attacks.

audio/en/463e13ebcd430624664e.m4a.text: Masquerading makes information appear to come from an identity that is not its true source.

audio/en/35e1c6b7598046acbcb0.m4a.text: Authorization determines which resources and actions an identity may access.

audio/en/184b332296df5205ccac.m4a.text: Access beyond granted permission is unauthorized access.

audio/en/c0f6ef4176532b0bbc51.m4a.text: A virus requires a host, while a worm is a standalone program.

audio/en/bbc82091249de547198d.m4a.text: A logic bomb activates when a predefined condition is met.

audio/en/db856457494ac877edf6.m4a.text: Spyware collects information without appropriate authorization.

audio/en/955d2bbb8b3ab91193d0.m4a.text: Delivery describes how malware reaches a target device.

audio/en/8dff21eee9fc7e72593e.m4a.text: Propagation describes how malware spreads between targets.

audio/en/aadd54a4e0cdcef3fb3f.m4a.text: A malicious payload performs the harmful action of the malware.

audio/en/0b7e6bb9310302c1cfaf.m4a.text: Cookies are stored data, not executable programs.

audio/en/0cfe39419cd0bf4188fb.m4a.text: Cookies can support sessions, preferences, and tracking.

audio/en/9ff44baf61f2af55275c.m4a.text: Tracking can threaten privacy even when no malware is installed.

audio/en/d14b064200cfea768200.m4a.text: Social engineering exploits human judgment to defeat security measures.

audio/en/9c34910246021f4cae84.m4a.text: Phishing impersonates a trusted source to deceive a victim.

audio/en/52bc2d1af48b0245c498.m4a.text: The sample quiz defines spam as unsolicited commercial email.

audio/en/79a1e31d059b0fb2b8e1.m4a.text: Industry 4.0 integrates connected devices, networks, computing, and intelligent analysis.

audio/en/72e83c4eff7e358c3faf.m4a.text: IoT devices support industrial connectivity but can introduce security vulnerabilities.

audio/en/919fd3245bf0e79855b6.m4a.text: The Sample Quiz associates the origin of Industry 4.0 with Germany.

audio/en/9a1218e12ebeb33fa154.m4a.text: A digital twin is a digital representation of a physical asset, process, or system.

audio/en/fd968786ddb86e1e1497.m4a.text: Digital twins can support simulation, product improvement, and virtual prototyping.

audio/en/c7182c7b3676d5310188.m4a.text: Reliable digital twins depend on the integrity of their data and models.

audio/en/aabf3ee0b6ec5da1fc47.m4a.text: Cloud computing uses network-accessible remote resources to store and process data.

audio/en/0fc83ce14f49bb89872f.m4a.text: Distributed denial of service attacks threaten service availability.

audio/en/cab9979e733f0621bbcb.m4a.text: Unauthorized disclosure threatens confidentiality, while unauthorized modification threatens integrity.

audio/en/6cf465b6aaae3c97857f.m4a.text: Employee behavior can cause security incidents intentionally or unintentionally.

audio/en/c5cb812cc5bea27e53b8.m4a.text: Errors and omissions do not require malicious intent.

audio/en/022476ee40547093785b.m4a.text: Fraud and retaliation are different from accidental mistakes.

audio/en/f2ae0bbcfb7eacbee0c5.m4a.text: Security awareness helps people recognize risks and responsibilities.

audio/en/cb4cbab5ba3b7a10720a.m4a.text: Security training teaches what people should do and how they should do it.

audio/en/e199362b81de05d6aa33.m4a.text: An effective awareness policy requires participation and allocates time for it.

audio/en/03d8600d5839b25308a0.m4a.text: Spear phishing tailors deception to a specific target.

audio/en/6669a83a6d8c86a90cc0.m4a.text: Vishing uses voice communication to deceive victims.

audio/en/0941b13f19f154d3baa8.m4a.text: Caller ID can be spoofed and is not sufficient proof of identity.

audio/en/12b0be2eb0ff38696b9d.m4a.text: A familiar name or photograph does not prove that an account is genuine.

audio/en/714cd63cfb6dba8c0e21.m4a.text: Search ranking alone does not establish a website's authenticity.

audio/en/5b6ea1c6c93f692d587b.m4a.text: Suspicious requests should be checked through an independently trusted channel.

audio/en/5ba1e167e7c0fbba793e.m4a.text: Cybersecurity compliance means following applicable standards and requirements.

audio/en/5cb423c30f32876fe542.m4a.text: A compliance team coordinates responsibilities across a compliance program.

audio/en/3204f955f01f1f61f3ac.m4a.text: Passwords are technical controls, while fences are physical controls.

audio/en/ada2a4882bf0e251f737.m4a.text: Security planning begins with an assessment of the current security state.

audio/en/d99d04570f8e09727e89.m4a.text: An assessment identifies assets, threats, vulnerabilities, and existing controls.

audio/en/3f8673adf462636cea62.m4a.text: Security controls should address the risks identified by the assessment.

audio/en/9e1bfa7c80640715bac3.m4a.text: Top management support is essential throughout all project stages.

audio/en/13be7f694a0a47c06abe.m4a.text: Management should provide an adequate budget for cybersecurity.

audio/en/8ec0359ac80d5651233a.m4a.text: Managers demonstrate commitment by following security procedures themselves.

audio/en/de8b05b44c534cb7d0cf.m4a.text: A policy states what should be done under specific circumstances.

audio/en/1888da6ba4e69ec36038.m4a.text: A procedure describes how to implement policy guidance.

audio/en/6f5f684e770220d4b1c1.m4a.text: Impractical security policies may encourage users to bypass them.

audio/en/32627cf75e62c167db1d.m4a.text: Standards are mandatory within the applicable organizational framework.

audio/en/319ba74540897e80e549.m4a.text: Guidelines recommend actions and allow discretion in their application.

audio/en/aa426c8cd642ecb963bf.m4a.text: This quiz requires decision makers to consider guidelines carefully.

audio/en/9afb25c528bfc23aa889.m4a.text: Authentication verifies identity, while authorization determines permissions.

audio/en/2210040728a79b5c6751.m4a.text: The three classic authentication factors are something you know, have, and are.

audio/en/136cbac92dcfb1ecda6b.m4a.text: Successful authentication does not grant permission to perform every action.

audio/en/a7ea6d05f6c5241caa4c.m4a.text: Predictable passwords are vulnerable to guessing attacks.

audio/en/1d7846610b868289d0ae.m4a.text: Reusing a password can spread the impact of a single account leak.

audio/en/5b1cad18341d0e21414c.m4a.text: Actual password attack difficulty also depends on the system's protections.

audio/en/f760fbf9da346333ec14.m4a.text: Biometrics use physiological or behavioral characteristics to check identity.

audio/en/34f5ba8ec049b355d309.m4a.text: Enrollment creates a reference template for later biometric comparisons.

audio/en/bc11eb4f895f32793fa7.m4a.text: Biometric authentication can be convenient without being immune to spoofing.

audio/en/8127a285613b92dddc4d.m4a.text: False acceptance incorrectly admits an unauthorized user.

audio/en/0c476da9dfeeda9eafd5.m4a.text: False rejection incorrectly denies a legitimate user.

audio/en/29a97b10bbe0fc794c3b.m4a.text: Deception is a deliberate attempt to fool an authentication system.

audio/en/80a40d16195b114d6bcb.m4a.text: Decryption recovers plaintext from ciphertext using the appropriate key.

audio/en/5320b05251e7930170aa.m4a.text: A block cipher processes fixed-size blocks of data.

audio/en/08f9fe1a240e2c35d7f3.m4a.text: Symmetric encryption uses the same shared secret key for encryption and decryption.

audio/en/1d22f8939da913f2d8d4.m4a.text: DES has a 64-bit block size and a 56-bit effective key.

audio/en/5c26eff3fbfc43c780a0.m4a.text: Secure key distribution is a major challenge in symmetric cryptography.

audio/en/ad51098a86f6df6b53e1.m4a.text: A claim of unbreakable encryption is not evidence of security.

audio/en/5017965b60f26dc0f629.m4a.text: The age of an algorithm alone does not prove its security.

audio/en/a7a878c0580301990035.m4a.text: New cryptographic methods require careful evaluation.

audio/en/fefceb8b5288e0c0f0b8.m4a.text: Asymmetric cryptography uses a public key and a corresponding private key.

audio/en/4f984193c2e10a219ab2.m4a.text: RSA is an asymmetric cryptographic algorithm.

audio/en/f2c452555143579f3b5a.m4a.text: Using two keys does not automatically make encryption more secure.

audio/en/512967f8054f1ceaac08.m4a.text: The course associates Diffie-Hellman with the difficulty of discrete logarithms.

audio/en/98a85a61a8a950e6f010.m4a.text: Unauthenticated key agreement does not verify the identity of the other party.

audio/en/9299d7322c1dea7cc55c.m4a.text: The RSA modulus is the product of two distinct prime numbers.

audio/en/2e8c3abb16d06577e5f5.m4a.text: For distinct primes p and q, phi of n equals p minus one times q minus one.

audio/en/7f2ac90b058d1019093e.m4a.text: When p is five and q is eleven, n is fifty-five and phi of n is forty.

audio/en/6eac95030075502b0c07.m4a.text: For confidentiality, encrypt with the receiver's public key.

audio/en/71ef1743c5e9dd063b97.m4a.text: The receiver decrypts with the corresponding private key.

audio/en/b4f23eb2b3408f90d04c.m4a.text: The sender uses the sender's private signing key to create a digital signature.

audio/en/209d02d94bb92d6038dd.m4a.text: A digital certificate binds an identity to a public key.

audio/en/ab4c0628e40aef2bf97b.m4a.text: A certificate authority digitally signs certificates.

audio/en/c793ddfed3b10c76dda8.m4a.text: A digital certificate does not disclose the subject's private key.

audio/en/c2264b16a8d00e5e0a8d.m4a.text: A cryptographic hash function produces a fixed-length message digest.

audio/en/5c9dc64967c2d731da72.m4a.text: An unkeyed hash alone does not authenticate the sender.

audio/en/d2e9ff9a54a06b27eebc.m4a.text: A sender creates a digital signature using the sender's private signing key.

audio/en/d2f558ab8d98985f453c.m4a.text: A verifier checks a digital signature using the signer's public key.

audio/en/68e5d188af6555b1232b.m4a.text: A digital signature supports integrity and source authentication, but does not itself provide confidentiality.

audio/en/02a2fa80128053a4d90d.m4a.text: A hybrid cryptosystem combines asymmetric and symmetric cryptography.

audio/en/03675752d4a1b6de3fc0.m4a.text: Public-key mechanisms can establish a shared session key.

audio/en/28b6f756c989f8970093.m4a.text: Symmetric encryption protects the session data in the course's hybrid model.

audio/en/ca1b5afdffa2fffddf79.m4a.text: The TLS handshake establishes security parameters and shared key material.

audio/en/f7af00b3186c48343e77.m4a.text: A cipher suite identifies a combination of cryptographic algorithms.

audio/en/bdf36b3caf3c847c79db.m4a.text: HTTPS protects HTTP communication by using TLS.

audio/en/9314075edbbd75951f40.m4a.text: TLS record protection provides confidentiality and message integrity for protected data.

audio/en/a040522260e0e1e67c85.m4a.text: Confidentiality prevents unauthorized disclosure of information.

audio/en/d54819d5f48c01016af3.m4a.text: Integrity protection detects unauthorized changes to protected data.

audio/en/46f93a6ffec9eaed0323.m4a.text: The TLS alert protocol communicates connection conditions to the peer.

audio/en/0636f04337b22920da7f.m4a.text: An alert is a protocol message rather than a digital certificate.

audio/en/816b1570742ade1a6894.m4a.text: An alert can report a problem or signal an orderly connection closure.

audio/en/90418c9f165b33c48582.m4a.text: A firewall enforces a policy on traffic passing through it.

audio/en/ae5a766bacf5b9a75035.m4a.text: A personal firewall controls network traffic for an individual computer.

audio/en/28bdf2368a3186b0c47b.m4a.text: A firewall cannot directly inspect traffic that bypasses it.

audio/en/1bf8618870248db59580.m4a.text: A packet filter applies rules to individual packet headers.

audio/en/4b7306933fc406faf0ea.m4a.text: A stateless packet filter does not track the state of a connection.

audio/en/1dd42ea042d74f6ae03b.m4a.text: Packet filtering can forward or discard a packet according to policy.

audio/en/8f0048849e45c3d2e8d0.m4a.text: IP address spoofing falsifies a packet's source address.

audio/en/3a3f881fe00df45ec525.m4a.text: A claimed source address is not proof of the sender's identity.

audio/en/d0f83b338160d3de219f.m4a.text: An external attacker may spoof an internal address to exploit address-based trust.

audio/en/e45c2b2a09bf208673d0.m4a.text: A host-based IDS monitors activity on an individual host.

audio/en/7abddd39fe3e39a826c8.m4a.text: A network-based IDS monitors traffic at network observation points.

audio/en/8bb12ee147a85c51b6a2.m4a.text: An intrusion detection system can produce false alarms or miss attacks.

audio/en/a7e7ca4264dcfe19b1b7.m4a.text: Signature detection searches for known attack patterns.

audio/en/0896c90abceb5c7a3ae4.m4a.text: Anomaly detection identifies deviations from expected behavior.

audio/en/1310237c4f04ef9f4b4f.m4a.text: Unusual behavior is not automatically malicious behavior.
